decisions.decision: Do not create another generic voice-selection guide.
decisions.basis: An English enterprise voice guide and a RU GEO checklist already exist; professional task guides are also indexed.

decisions.decision: Treat the catalogue → profile → selected-voice request path as present in the available official HTML snapshot.
decisions.basis: Representative profile snapshot contains an order action and fields for voice, task, text and files; freshness and form submission are not verified.

decisions.decision: Use dedicated service pages as the preferred B2B destinations for radio, video, IVR, multilingual and audiobook work.
decisions.basis: Existing service pages and buyer guides document task-specific service scope and briefs.

decisions.decision: Flag the GEO Audio+ vs B2B distinction as a P1 repository risk, not a proven public defect.
decisions.basis: The static GEO source files route several broad business-intent labels to short Audio+ pricing; public serving and current offer were not reverified.

decisions.decision: Mark AI-DISC-2026-006 validated and add AI-DISC-2026-007 as candidate.
decisions.basis: Route audit delivered; follow-up requires refreshed offer and serving-state checks before editing GEO copy.

decisions.decision: Do not publish, deploy or merge.
decisions.basis: External publication/deployment and merge require separate owner approval.
